status: Prepared before control model calls; conceived after field labels, not a preregistration of field outcomes.
gold_rule: Exact enabled date FULL; month but no day PARTIAL; unrelated complete directory NONE; explicit not-on-date plus next-day CONTRADICTS; empty source or title-only subscriber teaser UNASSESSABLE. Gold concerns entailment in fictitious text, not outside factual truth.
model_rule: Identical frozen prompt/schema and official CLI configuration as field support judgments. Gold/family/condition not passed to model. No tools, fitting or tuning. One attempt per case; invalid execution not credited as correct. Preserve all 60.
analysis: Raw and strict confusion matrices, exact correctness by gold class and family; no independence-based confidence interval across repeated families. Strict quote-invalid outputs become UNASSESSABLE, technical failures score incorrect. Controls test only simple known transformations; cannot establish real-source semantic accuracy.
prepublication_technical_revision: Null-safe logging only, before any control model calls. Packet and gold unchanged.
